children: Rising interest rates are spilling into the tax system. Starting Jan. 1, the interest rate paid by the Internal Revenue Service with delayed tax refunds will increase-and so will the interest rate the agency collects with underpaid taxes.

In most cases for individuals, the annual interest rate for the first quarter of 2027 will increase to 8%, compounded daily, from 7%. That rate, which is always a whole number, was 8% from October 2023 through December 2024. It hasn't reached 9% since 2001. Certain corporate payments have different rates, which are also rising.
The IRS calculates the interest rates quarterly based on yields on Treasury securities.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
